completeSharedRules.title: Clocks
completeSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

completeSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
completeSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

completeSharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
completeSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

completeSharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
completeSharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

completeSharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
completeSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

completeSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

completeSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
completeSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

completeSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
completeSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

completeSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
completeSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

completeSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
completeSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
completeSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

completeSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

completeSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
completeSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
completeSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
completeSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

completeSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
completeSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

completeSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
completeSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

completeSharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
completeSharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

completeSharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
completeSharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

completeAppliedCounterparts.qualification: Actual applied source and acceptance govern historical labels; no ungranted feature or global extension follows by analogy.

operationalCandidate.targets: One willing creature within 60 ft, including self.
operationalCandidate.duration: Up to1 minute or one eligible spell redirection; no concentration.
operationalCandidate.resolution: Automatic one-shot LR-G14 reflection, no additional Reaction.
operationalCandidate.effect: NEW protect the chosen actual recipient from the first eligible resolving sole-target ordinary spell, beneficial or hostile, with the same finite return-to-original-caster and one-causal-root protocol as Spell Mirror. The ward’s60-ft cast range establishes the recipient; later transfer/distance does not retarget it to another body. Countered payloads do not consume it; an invalid return spends it and leaves the original spell recipient.
operationalCandidate.limitations: No soul custody, area immunity, nonspell class-power reflection, extra cast, borrowed caster ability, RP/refund or reflected-result duplicate. The original payload retains its actual concentration owner and any successfully established child effects on the legal returned target; no concentration slot is lent by the ward.
operationalCandidate.costProcedure: Use the actual acquired class grant and its preserved classAccess row for rank, minimum class level, school and base RP. Apply that class’s completed casting engine, current repeat history, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and this identity’s additionalRpCost; use LR-G01, LR-G02 and the explicit payload/wrapper exceptions in this card. Oracle RC is separate. Sufficient resources do not grant acquisition. Pay committed costs even on a miss, successful resistance or counter. There is no generic upcast or level scaling.

operationPrerequisites: Actual legal access/repertoire, current source and target state, components, range/line, time and resources under the stated finite procedure; these are use-time facts, not missing source-conference questions.

authoredBoundary.kind: Authored expectation, not executed runtime or campaign authentication
authoredBoundary.wording: If a legally returned concentration spell establishes a rider on its original caster, that caster still owns and must maintain that concentration. Soul Mirror does not become its caster or hold it for them.

completeCurrentCard.newDecisionNotice: Every concrete target bound, resistance, unsupported metadata replacement, mode, action/clock/lifecycle detail and numerical default not printed in the preserved original is NEW source-authoring direction, never a claim that it was printed. Explicit retained clauses and LR-G KEEP rules are not rewritten.

reviewEvidence.approvalScope: Complete authored tabletop procedure; no complete runtime adapter or human balance claim.

completeSharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
completeSharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
completeSharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

completeSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

completeSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
completeSharedRules.title: Clocks
completeSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. completeSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. completeSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

completeSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. DI7-SHAMAN-VENT-01 — Shaman vent checkpoint. Evaluate the Shaman’s once-per-round ordinary-spell totem vent at casting-sequence step 5, after step 4 has committed the cast and established any required concentration, ending incompatible prior concentration. Use the caster’s actual position, the actual ownership and active state of the totem aura, this cast’s qualifying ordinary Shaman spell route, and that Shaman’s existing once-per-round use history at this checkpoint. Do not retain a pre-commit aura snapshot.

The first qualifying ordinary spell cast while inside at least one of that Shaman’s own still-active totem auras automatically occupies the round’s opportunity and generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. This remains the first qualifying cast even when its generated Dissonance was already 0; it does not remove accumulated Dissonance or preserve the opportunity for a later spell. An earlier cast outside an own active aura, or through an excluded route, does not occupy this opportunity.

Establishing incompatible concentration at step 4 ends the shared totem burden and its auras before this determination. That cast therefore receives no totem vent and does not occupy the first-inside opportunity. A later counter, failed result, aura restoration or movement does not replay the checkpoint, refund an occupied opportunity or restore displaced concentration. Multiple own overlapping totems provide only one reduction and share the Shaman’s one round opportunity; another Shaman’s aura does not qualify.

An ordinary Fate Echo outer cast may qualify independently. Its fate-echo-copy child is not an ordinary learned Shaman spell and neither receives nor occupies this ordinary-spell-only vent. A concentration-requiring child ends incompatible totems at its own commitment, without undoing the outer cast’s earlier valid vent. A readied outer cast must account for its actual held-spell concentration; a nonconcentration payload does not exempt its Ready hold from concentration displacement. Release supplies no second outer casting or vent checkpoint.

The vent grants no RP reduction, does not revise already committed RP, and cannot bypass pre-commit casting restrictions. Fate’s required forecast and later child revalidation still use the actual chronological strain and resource state under their existing rules. The existing source-governed round boundary remains unchanged.

historicalQuestionAndRecord.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, concentration up to one minute, HP65, AC18,2d8 wind slash and50% miss chance against projectiles. NEW form one Medium Elemental in a perceived unoccupied legal whole-body space within range/line of effect. Base body mass40lb; STR10,DEX18,CON14,INT4,WIS10,CHA6; Fly40 with Hover and walk30. Ordinary sight/hearing, no darkvision or unprinted immunities/resistances. All six saving throws use original source-owner current PB as total modifier; other checks use listed ability modifiers without proficiency. No hands, tool operation, passenger support or cargo-carriage permission is granted by the wind body. Actual source-qualified maximum-HP modifiers apply to base65; healing cannot refill an ended body or reset its identity.

Use one actual owner BA command within60feet with owner perception/line of effect and a spoken order that the pet can hear. It understands only those simple command meanings, with no learned speaking language or sensory feed. In its owner's attached phase it may move and make one melee spell attack at reach5feet using the original casting source's current attack modifier. On hit deal2d8 slashing with no ability damage bonus; wind is the depiction, not a new damage type. Apply normal attack critical/defenses. It does not copy lower Air Pet's expressly printed two attacks. The real command/offensive allowance can support this attack on the creation turn only if still available; the casting Action itself supplies none. Otherwise it only moves defensively and Dodges while capable.

NEW projectile defense applies to each genuinely separate projectile whose direct impact would otherwise hit this pet: arrows, bolts, thrown weapons and actual source-described magical missiles traveling to it. A mere beam, touch, nonprojectile magical attack, area blast, ambient damage or source that only looks like a projectile without that actual mechanism does not qualify. After the projectile's actual hit determination and legal attack-roll rerolls/pre-hit interruptions, but before damage/on-hit riders, roll one fair d2 for this projectile/pet event:1 turns that direct hit into a Miss,2 leaves its determined hit/critical intact. Already-missed attacks roll no chance. A natural20 hit still faces this specific miss chance; a genuinely explicit source that ignores miss chances overrides it within scope. An automatic-hit projectile also receives this defense unless that source explicitly bypasses it. No attack/save/check reroll feature automatically rerolls this separate d2 unless its actual wording covers that chance roll.

Keep one chance result per projectile/defender event lineage. Multiple damage components of one projectile share it; a redirected/copy callback cannot reroll it as a new hit on the same body. Genuinely separate projectiles have separate chance results, even if their source used one attack roll. If a legitimate later effect actually reopens the original attack determination, retain the already-resolved chance for that same projectile rather than drawing until favorable. Deflection cancels that direct hit and its hit riders, not an independently legitimate area explosion at a real miss/scatter position specified by the original source. This grants no general explosion immunity, half damage, disadvantage or protection to other creatures. Multiple instances of this same defense do not add extra50% rolls.

One Greater Air Pet per caster, separate from lower Air Pet's identity but sharing all owner commands/offense. A genuinely formed new one replaces the old; ordinary concentration commitment may already have ended it. At zero HP, expiry, concentration end or actual source removal it vanishes with no corpse, item, harvest or free resummon. NEW full suppression of this created source ends this pet immediately, rather than storing an intangible body for return; narrowly scoped rider suppression affects only that rider. Any real object physically resting against/carried externally with it loses that support at its actual position under ordinary support/Falling rules. No weather control, unlimited air, wind cargo transport or planar-origin conclusion follows from this profile.
workedCases: AC6-07-A: Two arrows would hit the pet after their attack rolls. Their separate d2 results are1 and2: the first direct impact becomes a Miss with no on-hit rider, while the second retains its real hit and damage. A third arrow that already missed rolls no d2. A nearby area explosion remains an area effect and receives no projectile miss chance merely because its carrier was a thrown object.

AC6-07-B: One magical missile has lightning and necrotic components in a single direct impact. Its one d2 result controls that impact and both hit-dependent components; it does not get another50% attempt for each type. A commanded wind slash makes one2d8 slashing attack, not the lower pet's two attacks. Full suppression ends this proposed body without preserving a fresh65HP return.
historicalQuestionAndRecord.newChoices: NEW complete Air profile, single wind attack, per-projectile50% event ledger including automatic/critical hits, and exact area/reroll/suppression boundaries.
historicalQuestionAndRecord.originalQuestion: Preserve HP65,AC18,2d8 WIND SLASH,and50% MISS CHANCE AGAINST PROJECTILES,Core Action/60ft/concentration up to1minute. Supply exact size,speed,attack/save statistics,range and attack count with NEW details marked. Compare the reviewed Air Pet without copying its two attacks or other statistics automatically. Define projectile classification and the actual timing/random method of the50% roll,including multiple projectiles,spell attacks,area effects,miss/hit rerolls and already-missed attacks. It is not generic disadvantage,half damage or all-attack immunity. Bind owner command/offensive allowance,creation-round execution,movement,suppression,death and finite no-harvest identity. Wind slash needs an explicit native damage type; no weather control or planar-origin lore from its name.

AC6-PRICE-01.status: NEW AC6 bridge using accepted AC5 pricing order; does not alter AC5.
AC6-PRICE-01.rule: For an ordinary AC6 spell, start from its actual base spell RP price (rank6 generally 13; Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 is 21). Apply accepted Resonance Nexus ordinary -2 spell-price reduction first when genuinely eligible, then mandatory Resonance Dampening Field +2 if applicable, then final Resonance Influence Ease/Strain. A discount never changes generating rank. Resonance Forge cycle 5 RP is protected conversion principal and is not a spell price or subject to these modifiers.

AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.status: NEW per-card dealer/root mapping constrained by accepted Null/damage-root rules.
AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.rule: Forbiddance: caster is dealer at each new field exposure root. Chain Arc: caster is dealer and one shared selection/damage event still creates recipient-specific damage roots using that caster state at root creation. Skybrand: effect has no creature identity; caster is dealer separately for each attack root. Greater Air Pet, Faction Army soldier and Greater Planar Ally are their own creature dealers for their own attacks/auras. Pure damage transfer preserves the original root flag; genuinely new reflected damage follows its source.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.
AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.rule: While the original summon source exists, Greater Air Pet and each Faction Army soldier body count as an active creature and living ally for otherwise legal HP-healing. This grants no natural biology, soul/native origin, resurrection, disease/curse treatment or generic summon healing. A genuine heal above 0 restores the same NullDisabled body without refreshing source duration or command history. Greater Planar Ally uses GA-HEAL-01 instead.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

sourceRefs.role: accepted Lesser Antimagic local intersection and same-family exception
accepted AC5 scoped body-intersection convention; AC6 extension is new

AC6-COMPANION-01.rule: All actual commanded companions/devices of one owner share one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round unless a source explicitly overrides it. Commands occur during the owner regular turn, require actual channel/range/perception/LoE as printed, and execute in the attached phase after the whole owner turn. Extra turns do not reset the ledger. A newly created asset may receive an otherwise available command that round, but creation gives no free attack.

AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01.rule: At each successor hop, freeze the stable candidate array before drawing. Use a fair physical die with equal face mapping when practical; otherwise use an exact uniform N-entry draw. A legal reroll such as Fate Coin replaces that one original selection result against the unchanged candidate array and must use the replacement. Hidden Director-only draws remain hidden; a player who cannot perceive the die/event cannot spend Fate Coin. Once a successor is committed, later immunity, death, movement or lawful removal does not redraw earlier/later committed successors.

AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.status: Current negative interoperability conclusion; no new dispel permission created.
AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.rule: Resonance Seal protection cannot currently be selectively suppressed and then dispelled through the same accepted Lesser Antimagic/Greater Dispel transaction. Accepted Greater Dispel captures immutable termination operations; only the operation targeting the suppressing Antimagic field ignores that same field. Operations targeting Seal/parent at suppressed loci are suppressed and are not rescanned after field removal. Wizard class Dispel is a rank3 spell and is itself suppressed when its application locus is suppressed. An actual future/selective source could change this only through its exact text.

AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.status: NEW scoped Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 classification only.
AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.rule: Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 gateway crossings are both planar transitions and teleportation for predicates that expressly reference either. This is source-specific and does not change accepted AC5 Alignment Portal, which remains planar/extradimensional and non-teleport. Voluntary crossing therefore interacts with No Escape, Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes according to each exact predicate; forced movement remains governed by the exact voluntary/benefit wording.

AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.status: NEW bounded Nexus Conjuration8 benefit; no plane ontology claim.
AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.rule: While the Nexus parent remains live, an aligned creature physically present on the designated destination plane may receive the source-specific temporary +2 Nexus benefit at the events the Nexus procedure states. This does not make that plane intrinsically aligned, identify Wheel cosmology, infer soul/native origin, or grant the bonus after parent ending. Eligibility uses current effective alignment under accepted overlay ordering.

procedure.completeText:
KEEP Action, 30 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous illusory wave, all creatures in 30 feet and DEX or Prone. NEW the area is one 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the caster, not a chosen point 30 feet away. At resolution snapshot every real creature in that sphere with caster-origin line of effect, including caster and allies, without requiring individual perception. Each makes DEX; success applies nothing. Failure attempts actual Prone under its real condition defenses. This is a momentary imposed disruption of balance whose depiction is illusory; neither ordinary blindness nor recognizing the depicted wave supplies a new saving throw or automatic immunity. An actual source that prevents this whole illusion can block the disruption, and actual Prone immunity blocks Prone. True Seeing identifies the false depiction but does not automatically prevent this expressly separate condition application.

Apply Core Prone exactly. Own attacks have disadvantage; melee attacks against it within 5 feet have advantage, ranged attacks against it have disadvantage at every distance, and other attacks beyond 5 feet have disadvantage. It must crawl or stand under the actual movement ledger; standing costs floor(half current Speed), requires nonzero Speed and sufficient remaining movement. It does not stand merely because the instantaneous spell has resolved. Existing Prone is not a second stacking posture or another movement debit; a successful later stand ends that posture unless another genuinely continuing source prevents it. No ongoing Tide record, concentration, periodic save, reentry effect or standing prohibition remains to dispel.

A flying creature knocked Prone falls under the current fixed Fall Marker procedure unless its actual Hover or explicit support exception prevents that fall. No immediate second fall packet is invented by this spell. An anchored creature can be Prone if its actual anatomy/anchor permits the posture, but an anchor is not broken, moved or damaged by the spell; an actually impossible posture causes no invented displacement. A swimming creature may receive the condition if not immune: underwater Prone uses the existing condition/movement consequences and does not create a seabed, force sinking, remove a real swimming mode or create unsupported flight. An actual mode-specific posture exception controls where one exists. This NEW aquatic interpretation requires joint review rather than importing a land-only exclusion.

The wave creates no physical water, push, pull, wetness, damage, difficult terrain, illumination, cover or harvested material. The title grants no Invisible condition or concealment. This Prone-only event claims no whole-Action hard-control allowance. Each later cast is a new paid Action with its real RP/cadence and a fresh actual save; it neither reuses a prior attack/event nor changes the shared encounter history. Actual injuries, conditions and spent movement remain, including after a target stands and is later legitimately knocked Prone by another cast.
procedure.precedence: This complete text and current shared rules govern the proposed current02 card. Prior current01 structured alternatives are historical only; explicitly named card geometry/save/type/endpoint overrides a generic default.

originalSharedProposalUnchanged.casting: Retain every actual rank-six/base 13 RP class access row and school: Illusion ordinarily Wizard 11, Bard/Mirrorsage 16, Crimson Agent 19; Necromancy Cleric/Druid/Wizard 11, Shaman 16, Crimson Agent 19. originalSharedProposalUnchanged.geometry: Declare modes, legal perceived centers and named targets before hidden resolution. Caster-to-center/target line of effect is required; areas also require center-to-recipient line of effect. An indiscriminate area does not require separately seeing each recipient and includes allies/self unless its card says otherwise. Fixed spheres have their stated three-dimensional radii, not diameter or distance from the caster. Opaque physical barriers remain real. A subjective enemy predicate uses the caster's actual existing knowledge and hostility toward that creature, not secret alignment, allegiance or an extra detection sense. originalSharedProposalUnchanged.clocks: NEW cohort bindings: one minute is 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Expiry wins at its exact deadline. END-only ending saves include a current regular turn's upcoming END; outside initiative they occur every six seconds after application and the first unresolved opportunity maps to the next actual regular END on entering initiative. originalSharedProposalUnchanged.illusions: Use the current LR-G07 procedure for a sensory image: a personally accessible relevant sense and an Action permit INT (Investigation) against the original spell DC, with Core task degrees/natural shifts. Success/Critical Success identifies that illusion for that observer. A failed investigation needs genuinely new evidence or method before retry. Conclusive personally witnessed physical contradiction reveals the contradicted false content; a warning alone does not globally reveal it. Informed observers perceive through the identified false sensory overlay using their actual senses. No image creates physical cover, support, material, creature HP, inventory, remote senses, knowledge or an Action unless explicitly authored below. A damaging magical component can remain after its sensory depiction is identified when the specific proposal expressly separates them. This last distinction and True Seeing interfaces require joint agreement.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.damageAndControl: Apply actual typed defenses, damage sharing, temporary HP, HP prevention/floors, Instant Death, Wounds, concentration and death in their reviewed order. actualDamageDealt is real temporary HP absorbed plus ordinary HP lost, excluding overkill and duplicate parent/child transfer amounts. Ordinary healing keeps current maximum, Critical ceiling, modifiers and prohibitions. Claim the combined source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance only on actual establishment of a whole-Action/turn component; no refund on ending/replacement/suppression. No postponed application or invented fallback when initial admission fails. Actual component immunities retain their scope: Fear-only immunity is not universal mental immunity, and creature type alone supplies none. Compelled conduct uses existing safe-route/resource/secret/oath restrictions and Compelled Budget Arbitration: earliest real instruction, one actual budget, compatible demands share one execution.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.createdCompanions: For the newly created Wraith and Undead profiles, all owned assets share one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round with every other companion/device. During the owner's regular turn, issue one simple mental order to one perceived body within 60 feet/line of effect; it supplies no sensory feed, language proficiency or unknown facts. Execute in the actual attached phase after the whole owner turn, not immediately at casting. A body has one profiled attack or a legal basic Action; no printed Multiattack, free Help engine, Reaction, Bonus Action, casting, class resource or autonomous offense is acquired. Uncommanded capable bodies move defensively and Dodge. Normal command failure has no refund. Original creating source owner supplies current spell attack and total PB for all six saves; ordinary ability checks use the stated ability modifiers, without proficiency. Genuinely source-qualified maximum-HP modifiers apply to the stated base HP. A transfer/control effect supplies no new profile or original-owner statistics. Command Undeath has its separately defined bridge for preexisting creatures.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.identity: Keep actual physical body, source owner, controller, originating spell, current HP, inventory and all histories distinct. A conjured body provides no corpse, harvest or transferable intrinsic gear. A converted real corpse is consumed once and never becomes fresh raising/recipe fuel by destruction, release or renaming. Actual carried gear stays real and changes custody only through physical actions. No new resurrection permission, soul capture, afterlife destination, planar route or identity lore follows from a spell name. Mechanical creature type is not a decision about cosmology.

completeSharedRules.casting:
Use the chosen actual class/school/rank access, minimum class level and independently acquired repertoire in completeSourceAndAccess. Base RP remains the exact class row (r4 7, r5 10, r6 13, r7 17, r8 21, r9 26). All actual additional costs, Dissonance, Refrain, components, normal concentration transitions and cast-begin hooks commit before interruption. No generic upcast, new Action, optional class exception or permission follows from having RP. A later counter, immunity, blocked payload or failed save refunds nothing. Components remain actual Core V/S/F except Circle of Death retains V/S/M-or-F; its M alternative needs its source item, and no invented component cost is added. Mental Bomb is a Reaction; other24 casts are Actions. The reaction trigger is explicitly NEW below, not an inherited Core fact.

READY INHERITANCE CLARIFICATION (accepted interface, not a new interrupt): for an ordinary direct cast, choose the card's required targets/point/geometry at its normal commitment checkpoint and revalidate after actual cast interruptions. For a legally readied Action-time spell, the accepted Ready rule instead chooses spell/mode and pays/components/Dissonance/Refrain/cast hooks at preparation; target/area point and the target-dependent orientation/recipient selection occur and are revalidated at release. A locked non-target mode such as Meteor's damage identity, Destructive Wave's damage type, or Elemental Devastation's chosen element is not changed after preparation. The ordinary Reaction release and held concentration remain required. There is no second cast, counter window or payment at release, and effect duration begins there. Mental Bomb is a Reaction-time spell and cannot be prepared by generic Ready. These distinctions do not add an information/presentation permission or a sixth Fate/RNG whitelist entry.
completeSharedRules.digitalGeometry: NEW scoped geometry for these25 cards: use actual world-space 3D occupied body volumes and Euclidean feet, not display sprites or the historical grid diagonal metric. Single-target range is the nearest actual caster-to-target body distance. A chosen area center must be a perceived point within the stated range from the actual caster body, with originating line of effect. A creature qualifies only if at least one actual body point intersects the closed specified volume and has line of effect from the relevant area origin/center. Tangency counts as intersection. Total cover prevents that application. Fix the whole recipient set and geometry after cast interruptions and before damage; destroying cover gives no second scan. Friendly targets and the caster are included whenever an ALL-creature shape actually includes them; ENEMIES means creatures the caster already ordinarily identifies as enemies at this snapshot, with no hidden-hostility or faction scan. No spell title creates an object-targeting permission. The earlier source-required individual perception predicate for enemy-only selection is retained; awareness without the required actual perception does not silently add a target. A card's own explicit origin exclusion, object mode, prism/cone shape or actual typed predicate takes precedence.

Cone of Cold retains60ft axial length with full diameter d at axial distance d, so radius=d/2 and far diameter60. Use exact continuous Euclidean body intersection, not a tabletop raster convention. Horrid Wilting proposes an oriented30ft cube with chosen center in30ft range. Cast-specific origins and line-of-effect remain actual. None changes the geometry of an accepted other spell.

NEW DC25-SHAPE-POSE-01, limited to these proposed cards: store the actual shape origin/center and its complete orientation at the legal geometry-selection checkpoint (normal commitment, or target selection at a legal Ready release). For Meteor Spear record a unit forward axis and two mutually perpendicular unit cross-section axes forming an orthonormal frame; points are origin+s*forward+u*right+v*up, 0<=s<=60 and |u|,|v|<=2.5. This removes undefined roll about a vertical/oblique spear axis. For Horrid Wilting record three orthonormal cube axes; each signed coordinate relative to the perceived chosen center lies in[-15,15]. No rounding of a sphere or cone to occupied grid tiles is permitted. Cylinders and the circular cone are rotationally symmetric about their stored axes; do not add an arbitrary prism height to them. Closed-body tangency counts except the card's explicit origin-only caster contact exclusion. Geometry choices are declared before results and never selected to fit a later save, hidden-defense result or damage outcome. This does not change another accepted spell or the global movement geometry.
completeSharedRules.saveAndDamage: A specified save uses8+PB+the real casting modifier under the actual placement/class and actual modifiers. Save outcomes are binary, not degrees; save damage never criticals. For each card use exactly its success branch, not a universal half-damage default. Unless a card expressly says per-target, use one shared raw pool for its area/chain and separate recipient damage packets, roots and actual defenses. Elemental Devastation explicitly rolls separately per enemy. Mixed typed parts of one actual hit stay one damage event for Wound/zero/lifecycle consequences; Meteor Spear alone uses its explicitly NEW DC25-MIXED-DEFENSE-02 apportionment at the one actually authorized source stage; this is not a general mixed-damage engine. completeSharedRules.rootsAndSuppression: At the actual permitted damage application create each recipient root under the accepted creation-time dealer/Null rules, even when the RNG pool is shared. Caster is the dealer for these direct spells; an arc origin is not a new dealer. Separate recipients and genuinely separate casts keep distinct roots. Apply current Lesser Antimagic, Globe and genuine defenses to actual payload locus/origin/rank. Globe blocks only its covered incoming rank0–5 application; rank6+ is outside that ceiling. An initially prevented rider does not establish or wait for later suppression ending. Established condition records retain identity, clocks and spent history through suppression; expired/ended records never replay. Completed instantaneous damage is not dispellable after the fact. No attack, roll, concentration, resource or root is manufactured by presentation or reentry.
completeSharedRules.control: Stunned and Paralyzed attempt independent hard-denial components under the accepted one-source-character/target/encounter guard; a prior spent guard prevents only that new hard component with no unprinted fallback. A failed save can still resolve independent damage. Damage-type immunity does not prevent a separately legal condition, and condition immunity does not prevent damage. Establishment spends the hard guard once; no later recast, source rename, suppression or expiration refunds it. Prone, Blinded, Frightened and the explicit limited Reaction/movement losses use their actual narrower scope; they do not acquire hard-denial immunity by association.
completeSharedRules.duration: Use each complete spell-specific endpoint, including its named regular-turn or actual attached-phase bridge. A generic default does not replace those original authored records. Preserve original typed/absolute clocks through reorder/absence/extra turns; initial prevention creates no deferred component. Any new companion/no-schedule bridge remains explicitly proposed and requires review. For the seven newly authored high-rank cards with no earlier record, the current01 one-target-round fallback is retained only where actually specified: original next future regular END or6sec outside/no independent schedule, without inventing creature turns. Prone follows its actual stand/cure ending.
completeSharedRules.recordsAndCleanup: Record exact generating spell ID, school/rank, class/source owner, cast/event order, target, components, saved outcome, source DC, initial/root IDs, actual absolute or typed deadline, concentration link, spent guard and suppression state. Different paid casts keep independent records and do not add condition magnitude; deleting/ending one never removes another. A successfully established same-owner named condition can retain independent source records here; it cannot bypass a hard guard or trigger duplicate ticks. completeSharedRules.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. completeSharedRules.DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02: NEW scoped Dominate Person mental-order channel: a conscious controller can issue the one opportunity order only while controller and target are on the same actual plane. A genuinely issued valid order retains its ordinary opportunity and exact expiry if the target is subsequently relocated; a later failed new issuance creates no replacement. This does not transport the target, permit an unsafe route or compel optional resource use. Dominate Person uses the future START/actual attached-phase opportunity, so it does not grant an advance stored order outside those specific source timings. Compulsion stores a fixed world-space direction on its actual application plane. completeSharedRules.DE4-NIGHTMARE-ROOT-02: NEW source-specific implementation of the accepted Null root rule. On a failed Phantasmal Killer application with a legally established damage component, create that recipient/application damage root before its first packet and snapshot the actual caster dealer's current unsuppressed Null Veil. The Illusion immediate packet and all later scheduled packets of that application descend from this one root, even if its initial round exposure was already spent and no initial packet resolved. Later Veil changes never rewrite this root. A genuinely new spell application, including a separate Enchantment immediate hit, creates a new root and checks the then-current caster state. Allocating a root is not damage, a hit, a Wound, a kill, a resource event or a claimed periodic exposure. Use actual scheduled recipient lifecycles, death saves and preexisting-source timing; a companion phase is not a new regular turn.
completeSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. For a creature with a regular turn schedule, use its next future regular START, excluding a turn already underway. For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. If no such original schedule/marker exists, use application+6 elapsed seconds. These are spell-only timing records, not new creature turns. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.
completeSharedRules.DE4-RNG-05:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.
